name: A Midtown Atlanta street
blurb: A tree-lined block in Midtown Atlanta: pavement and kerb, a strip of clipped turf between the walk and the buildings, live oaks and sycamores overhead with crepe myrtle and yaupon holly along the low fences, and chipmunks and grey squirrels on the grass by day, opossums and eastern red bats after dark.

facts.text: Under the Koppen classification Atlanta has a humid subtropical climate, Cfa.

facts.text: Atlanta sits 320 m (1,050 ft) above mean sea level, the highest elevation of any major city in the United States east of the Mississippi River.

source.title: Wikipedia: Atlanta

facts.text: Atlanta has the densest urban tree coverage of any major city in the United States.

source.title: Wikipedia: Atlanta
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Atlanta", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Atlanta's summers are hot and humid, with temperatures somewhat moderated by the city's elevation, and its winters are mild but variable.

facts.text: Midtown Atlanta is a neighbourhood of the city of Atlanta, in Fulton County, Georgia; Wikidata records 41,681 residents for it.
The northern mockingbird, a resident across the southern United States, copies other birds, animals and even artificial sounds such as car alarms, and sings by night in lit streets.

facts.text: A 2016 study carried out in Atlanta found that northern cardinals suppress West Nile virus after infection, unlike other species studied.
